kit.pick_for: Pick for slot {{index}} — or click a slot to change just that one.
kit.intro: The card on the left is what the guild looks like everywhere else. Every colour, banner, icon and tag below costs nothing, and you pick between them because you founded this guild. The plainer ones are yours from the start; the rest unlock as the guild levels up, and each tile says at what level. Choose one and the whole roster is wearing it a moment later.

stash.empty: Nothing here yet. Drag something down from your gear and somebody will use it.
stash.full: The shelf is full — take something off it, or put a few tokens towards another row in the Upgrades tab.
stash.how: Drag a socket into your own cabinet to take it, or click it. Leaving something earns honor by its rarity; taking anything off the shelf costs a flat {{cost}}, up to {{limit}} times a day. Who left what is in the ledger below.
stash.no_gear: You have no spare gear to give.
stash.gear_how: Guitars, pedals, salvaged parts and rescued mods all go on the shelf — drag one up, or click it. Dragging inside this board just rearranges it, and that is the arrangement your Arsenal shows. Equipping is cleared for you; a pedal has to come off the board first.
stash.ledger_body: Every deposit and every withdrawal, counted per member.

accent.label: Colour
accent.blurb: The one the rest of the kit is drawn from — change it and the banner, the icons and the frame follow.

banner.label: Banner
banner.blurb: The strip across the top of your card, in the guild list and on this page.

motif.label: Icons
motif.blurb: The four icons tiled across the banner. Any four you like.

frame.label: Tag
frame.blurb: How your tag is drawn next to every member's name on the board.

accent_steel.name: Steel
accent_steel.blurb: The plain one every guild starts in.

accent_ivory.name: Ivory
accent_ivory.blurb: Almost white. Reads before anything else on the board.

accent_bone.name: Bone
accent_bone.blurb: Warm grey, like an old pickguard.

accent_cobalt.name: Cobalt
accent_cobalt.blurb: Deep blue, cold as a rehearsal room in February.

accent_neon.name: Neon
accent_neon.blurb: Fuchsia. Nothing else on the board looks like it.

accent_crimson.name: Crimson
accent_crimson.blurb: Loud, and nobody else on the board is wearing it.

accent_ember.name: Ember
accent_ember.blurb: Streak orange, for a guild that never misses.

accent_sulphur.name: Sulphur
accent_sulphur.blurb: Yellow, a shade sharper than Brass.

accent_acid.name: Acid
accent_acid.blurb: Lime. Loud in a different way to Crimson.

accent_verdant.name: Verdant
accent_verdant.blurb: Green, the colour of a week cleared.

accent_lagoon.name: Lagoon
accent_lagoon.blurb: Teal, between the app's cyan and a week cleared.

banner_none.name: Bare
banner_none.blurb: No colour at all — just your icons on the plain strip.

banner_wash.name: Wash
banner_wash.blurb: Corner to corner: the colour laid in from the top left, thinning out towards the bottom right.

banner_aurora.name: Aurora
banner_aurora.blurb: Left to right through the colour's two neighbours.

banner_sunburst.name: Sunburst
banner_sunburst.blurb: Dark along the top, the colour gathering towards the bottom edge.

banner_stage.name: Dusk
banner_stage.blurb: From the colour at the top right into its cooler neighbour at the bottom left.

banner_halo.name: Fade
banner_halo.blurb: Out of the dark on the left and into the colour on the right.

frame_plain.name: Plain
frame_plain.blurb: Tag in the guild's colour, nothing around it.

frame_ring.name: Ring
frame_ring.blurb: A thin ring in the guild's colour.

frame_double.name: Double
frame_double.blurb: Two thin rings, with a hair of dark between them.

frame_plate.name: Plate
frame_plate.blurb: Filled, so the tag reads first on a busy row.

frame_heavy.name: Heavy
frame_heavy.blurb: Filled and ringed. The loudest a tag gets.

frame_solid.name: Solid
frame_solid.blurb: A block of the colour with the tag cut out of it in black.

frame_pill.name: Pill
frame_pill.blurb: Filled and fully rounded, like a button that never does anything.

frame_sunken.name: Sunken
frame_sunken.blurb: Cut into the row: a dark slot with the tag in the colour.

frame_brackets.name: Brackets
frame_brackets.blurb: A bar of the colour down each side of the tag.

frame_dot.name: Dot
frame_dot.blurb: A dot of the colour before the tag, the way a status light sits before a name.
